description.purpose: Loop ingress (capture role of examples/14b): mints turn_id, persists the user turn as thread row 0, and feeds the planner with persona + OpenAI-wrapped tool schemas + the user turn.
description.use_when: Entry of the research loop, directly behind the proxy.
description.not_in_scope: No history rebuild (collector's job), no answer shaping.
description.emits_meaning: route ustore: thread insert for the user turn (memory store). route ullm: system (persona incl. citation duty + tools as full OpenAI tool objects per extract_tools) + messages for the planner; hop.question/turn_id are promoted to context on the out-edge.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: a user text turn starts a round. Anything without a user turn (e.g. the store's insert reply echoing back via reply_to fallback) is swallowed (empty multi-send).
